overall: The AG found two violations (late posting of the February 21, 2012 notice and missing posting date/time stamp), found no violation on website placement, accepted the Committee's corrective steps, and closed the matter by informal action with an order of future compliance.

allegations.summary: Notice of the February 21, 2012 meeting was allegedly not posted at least 48 hours in advance, as the meeting fell after a holiday weekend.
allegations.key_passage: We find that the Committee violated the Open Meeting Law by failing to post notice of its February 21, 2012 meeting more than 48 hours prior to the meeting, excluding Saturdays, Sundays, and legal holidays.

allegations.summary: The notice did not bear a date and time stamp showing when it was posted, as required by 940 CMR 29.03(1)(b).
allegations.key_passage: The Committee also failed to conspicuously record thereon or therewith the date and time the notice for the Committee's February 21, 2012 meeting was posted.

allegations.summary: The February 21, 2012 notice was allegedly not conspicuously placed under the splash page of the district website as other notices were.
allegations.key_passage: Although we do not fmd that its failure to do so in the past was a violation of the Open Meeting Law, we commend the Committee for taking steps to ensure that the meeting notices posted to its website are easily accessible to the public.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law (G.L. c. 30A, §§ 18-25).
remedy_passage: We order the Committee's immediate and future compliance with the law, and caution that future similar violations may be considered evidence of intent to violate the law.
